chunks: And from him, from them, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Verily, when Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, created Adam (peace be upon him), He looked at his back and created Hawa (Eve) from it.'
Adam said: 'O Lord, why did You create her from my back?' He said: 'So that you may find rest/comfort in her.'
Then He said: 'And indeed, We created you and looked at your deeds.'

key_terms.ظَهْرِي: My back (indicating the source of Eve's creation)
key_terms.لِتَسْكُنَ إِلَيْهَا: So that you may find rest/comfort in her (purpose of creation)

ai.seo_question: How was Eve created according to Shia hadith sources?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq highlights this narration to underscore the divine wisdom (*hikmah*) behind Eve’s creation from Adam’s rib, framing it not merely as a physical origin but as a theological foundation for marital companionship (*sakinah*) and mutual tranquility. This aligns with the Shia emphasis on the continuity of divine observation (*muraqabah*) over human deeds, reinforcing that just as creation was intentional, so too is the accountability of those created.
